caseEvidence.detail: Actual buyer MCP, cloud authorization, MCPWire and native Ollama completed generation; only its HTTP response was held. Authenticated counters observed 1 completed native generation(s), one held response and 6 later metadata responses. Real 60000ms deadline produced durable DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; signed buyer retrieval matched failed state and a zero-charge receipt with no settlement. This is transport-delay injection, not physical sleep or a stalled native model.
Second physical Mac exists but is inaccessible to this agent. Local logical providers are not separate physical machines.
